services.desc: Join A Sightseeing Adventure On San Francisco Bay! This 90-minute sightseeing cruise is full of San Francisco icons, such as: The Golden Gate Bridge, Alcatraz Island, Angel Island, San Francisco Skyline, and Pier 39.Note: This tour does not dock at Alcatraz

blurb: From the bustling piers of San Francisco to the secrets waiting offshore, Alcatraz City Cruises invites you on a passage through time. Departing from Pier 33, sail across the bay with sweeping views of the Golden Gate Bridge, the city skyline, and the restless waters that once carried adventurers and fortune seekers.
